name: Collegio alla Querce,  Auberge Collection
positioning: Former boarding school in a Renaissance-era villa on a hillside above Florence, now an Auberge Collection hotel
best_for: Travelers who like a hotel with real history and design character
Guests who want a quiet hillside base with a shuttle into Florence

facts.text: The hotel sits on a hillside about 15 minutes north of Florence's historic center, with a complimentary shuttle running from 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM.
The hotel keeps an original chapel and theater.
Guest rooms and suites combine high Renaissance art with modern Italian design.
The hotel has a 2,250-square-foot signature Penthouse called la Quercia.
Rooms offer personal wine cellars, trunk closets and marble tubs.
La Gamella is the signature restaurant, with a seafood-driven approach combined with Tuscan country comforts.
Il Bosco is a poolside restaurant and bar set among terraced gardens and olive trees.
Bar Bertelli has a cigar room with hand-rolled Italian cigars in the evenings.
Aelia has a movement studio called Volta Dell'Angelo for mat pilates and yoga.
The hotel is 15 minutes by car from Florence airport.

highlights.text: The Renaissance-era villa became a boarding school before being reimagined as the hotel.
Bar Bertelli occupies the former headmaster's office.
Grand Suites include a complimentary minibar with an espresso machine and a signature cocktail on arrival.
Aelia partners exclusively with Furtuna Skin.

considerations.text: On-site parking costs EUR 60 per night.
Il Bosco Restaurant is open seasonally through September 30.
